abilities.name: Iron Skin
abilities.description: Activate to grant Johanna a Shield that absorbs 810 damage for 4 seconds. While this Shield is active, Johanna is Unstoppable.; 22; trait

fields.notes: If the Shield breaks, Johanna loses Unstoppable and any other benefits that come with it.

abilities.name: Punish
abilities.description: Step forward dealing 113 damage and Slowing enemies by 50% decaying over 2 seconds.

fields.notes: Using Punish causes Johanna to minidash into the target direction. Roots prevent the dash behavior, but do not disable the Ability altogether.

abilities.name: Condemn
abilities.description: After 1 second, Johanna pulls nearby enemies toward her, Stunning them for 0.25 seconds and dealing 55 damage. Deals 200% increased damage to Minions and Mercenaries.

fields.notes: Enemies hit by Condemn are in order first pulled, then damaged, and once the pull ends Stunned. Damage bonus to Minions and Mercenaries stacks additively with offensive damage modifiers that can affect Condemn 's damage.

abilities.name: Shield Glare
abilities.description: Deal 59 damage to enemies and Blind them for 1.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Falling Sword
abilities.description: Johanna leaps into the air for 2 seconds and she can steer the landing location by moving. While in the air, allies below Johanna are Unstoppable. Upon landing enemies hit take 225 damage and are Stunned for 0.25 seconds.; 50; 60; heroic

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Movement: Teleport, Status effect / Status effect
fields.props: Area of Effect, Stasis, Stun, Unstoppable
fields.notes: The cast is uninterruptible. The initial teleport can be used to cross over terrain or Structures, but the Ability cannot be targeted on top of them or steered into them, except for allied and enemy Gates. Immediately upon activating the Ability and while in the air, Johanna is put in Stasis. In addition to usual effects of Stasis, Johanna has no collision and after the initial delay removed from the ground plane. While targeting the landing area, Johanna moves at regular Movement Speed subject to allied and her own Movement Speed buffs applied beforehand. While in the air, Johanna gains vision over the target area. The range indicator for the Ability's initial cast shown in game is incorrect.

abilities.name: Blessed Shield
abilities.description: Deal 114 damage and Stun the first enemy hit for 1.5 seconds. Blessed Shield then bounces to 2 nearby enemies, dealing 57 damage and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.; 60; 90; heroic

fields.notes: Bounces prioritize Heroes and then the closest enemy to Johanna. Each bounce originates from the previous target. Enemies that are immune to skillshots cannot be hit by the initial projectile, but can be targeted by bounces as long as they are not also immune to AoE (Invulnerable targets therefore cannot be targeted by or hit by either).

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Shield Glare 's damage.

fields.notes: Slow amount also does not decay after completing the Quest.

talents.name: Holy Fury
talents.description: Deal 15 damage per second to nearby enemies. Each Hero hit by Condemn increases this damage by 40% for 5 seconds.

fields.notes: Holy Fury is inactive while Mounted. Holy Fury does not affect unaggroed neutral Mercenaries Damaging enemy Heroes with Holy Fury does not draw tower aggro. Damage from Holy Fury is unaffected by external offensive damage modifiers and lifesteal effects. Holy Fury 's damage bonus stacks additively with itself.

talents.name: Blessed Hammer
talents.description: cooldown 30 Activate to create 2 hammers that spiral outward from Johanna, dealing 65 damage to enemies hit. Damaging enemies with Basic Abilities reduces the cooldown of this Ability by 2 seconds. passive Every 3rd Basic Attack against enemy Heroes releases a Hammer.

fields.notes: Actually 2.5s of cooldown reduction per enemy hit by Basic Abilities, despite the tooltip. The Ability is interrupted if Johanna dies or is put in Stasis. Hammers spiral clockwise around Johanna, always starting from 10 o'clock and making 2.25 revolutions before reaching maximum radius and disappearing. The second hammer appears 1 second after the first. Enemies can be hit by Blessed Hammer multiple times, but not more often than once per 0.5 seconds.
